title: Legacy of the Observer
next_chapter_hook: The remnant will of the First Observer gradually dissipated in the void, yet at the final moment, it projected the image of Chen Nian before Chen Ji—within those eyes identical to his own lay the ultimate choice he must make.

text.content:
Deep within the heavens, that eye opened completely.

Not a metaphor, not a symbol—literally, an organ transcending three-dimensional comprehension, gazing upon this battlefield in a manner that made the soul tremble. Chen Ji felt every cell in his body pierced by countless gazes, every thought being instantly analyzed.

His Tianji Record shook violently at this moment, the golden patterns on the fragment burning to their limit, yet barely able to withstand that gaze from higher dimensions. Sweat slid down his temples, turning into scorched marks where it hit the ground—those were not water, but his Heavenly Fate Value visibly depleting.

dialogue.content: So this is... the Heavenly Dao's Eye?

text.content:
The air in the depths of the imperial mausoleum suddenly solidified.

The formation rune patterns beneath Chen Ji's feet began to crack, and countless golden points of light burst forth from the fissures, like stars imprisoned for ten thousand years finally finding release. Those light particles gathered, intertwined, and reorganized in the air, gradually outlining a vague humanoid silhouette.

It was a phantom of an elderly figure, clad in strange garments Chen Ji had never witnessed, surrounded by principles belonging to no era he recognized. His eyes were profound as an abyss, seemingly containing the rise and fall of the entire universe.

The remnant spirit of the First Observer manifested completely here.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng, is this the complete legacy left by the First Observer?

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul struggled to emerge from the fragment, his form more虚弱 than ever before, as if he might dissipate into the void at any moment.

"Chen Ji... the truth ahead may overturn your entire understanding of this world." His voice carried unprecedented solemnity. "What the First Observer left behind is not merely the ability to prophesy, but a complete record of this war's origins."

The elder's phantom slowly spoke, his voice like an ancient bell, making Chen Ji's eardrums ache:

"Successor, what you face is not the Heavenly Dao you believe in."

dialogue.content: Not the Heavenly Dao? Then what is that eye in the heavens?

text.content:
The elder's phantom raised his hand, and the mausoleum's dome suddenly became transparent, revealing the terrifying sky outside.

That massive eye still watched, but now Chen Ji could see more clearly—within its depths lay not the familiar Heavenly Dao Will, but a chaotic, multi-dimensional void transcending three-dimensional boundaries.

"The so-called Heavenly Dao is merely a puppet controlled by higher-dimensional beings." The elder's voice carried ten thousand years of sorrow. "Everything in our three-dimensional world—fate, prophecy, the Tianji Record—is merely experimental data in the eyes of those existences."

In the depths of the mausoleum, countless ancient murals suddenly illuminated. Chen Ji witnessed scenes that made his scalp tingle:

The three-dimensional world was insignificant as dust within a multi-dimensional universe, while countless higher-dimensional beings gazed upon this dust with greedy intent.

dialogue.content: The First Observer spent his entire life finally discovering this truth.

text.content:
The elder's phantom turned to Chen Ji, those universe-weary eyes directly staring into his soul.

"The Observer Project was never about opposing the Heavenly Dao—but about opposing dimensional invasion."

His voice echoed through the mausoleum, each word carrying the weight of ten thousand jun: "Generations of Observers were selected not because of talent or chance, but because our three-dimensional world needed an interface capable of perceiving higher dimensions. The Tianji Record is the bridge connecting the two dimensions."

Chen Ji felt his heart skip a beat.

He had always believed himself a rebel against destiny, a variable breaking prophecies. Yet he never imagined that from the very beginning, everything about him existed under the watchful gaze of those higher beings.

The golden patterns on the Tianji Record fragment suddenly flickered intensely, as if responding to something.

dialogue.content: So the Tianji Record fragment being selected for inheritance in the Chen family was merely an arrangement by those existences?

text.content:
The elder's phantom remained silent for a moment, then slowly shook his head.

"Not entirely."

He waved his hand, and a brilliant light condensed from the void, ultimately forming a complete golden page—the complete form of the Tianji Record!

"Generations of Observers have attempted to break this predicament. The First Observer discovered that only when the Tianji Record is sufficiently complete can one truly transcend dimensional shackles." The elder's voice grew impassioned. "The complete Tianji Record did not come from those beings' gift—it requires generations of Observers to supplement through their own Heavenly Fate Value and comprehension!"

Chen Ji stared intently at that complete golden page.

He saw intricate text and patterns emerging upon it, each line of the patterns containing principles and mysteries beyond current understanding. At the very bottom of that page, a line of faintly glowing text appeared:

"The Fourth Possibility—Transcending Three Dimensions."

dialogue.content: This is the ultimate solution left by the First Observer.

text.content:
As Chen Ji was about to speak, the Tianji Record fragment suddenly unfolded on its own, aligning with the complete golden page.

The void between the two pages began to distort, and countless images flickered rapidly before Chen Ji's eyes like a shifting kaleidoscope:

He witnessed the First Observer's solitary, desperate struggle against dimensional invasion; saw generations of Observers sacrificing themselves in an endless, heroic march; observed the three-dimensional world trembling at countless points of near collapse...

Finally, he saw his own destiny's trajectory.

At the end of that path lay four diverging roads:

First, merging with the Heavenly Dao's Eye to become a puppet of higher existences.

Second, gathering all Observers' power to seal the dimensional entrance, but this meant forever losing the possibility of breakthrough.

Third, abandoning the Tianji Record to live as a mortal, yet those beings would never spare those who knew too much.

Fourth...

Chen Ji gazed at that faintly glowing text, his heart nearly stopping.

The fourth possibility—to become an existence transcending three dimensions, serving as a conduit to guide the entire three-dimensional world through dimensional barriers.

But what would be the cost?

choice.prompt: Facing the allure of the fourth possibility, Chen Ji must make a critical choice:

choices.description: Fully embrace the First Observer's complete inheritance, gaining all the knowledge and power needed to break through dimensions, but this means accepting the fate of becoming a higher-dimensional being.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Emotional Bonds as a Human
choices.risk_hint: The cost may be losing everyone you care about

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: "This is your choice. Whatever the cost, I will respect it."

text.content: The elder's phantom nodded, and that complete golden page drifted slowly toward Chen Ji.

choices.description: Don't trust this inheritance lightly, suspecting it might be another trap set by dimensional beings, demanding the old man prove the authenticity of all this.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the true fortuitous opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more clues about the truth
choices.risk_hint: Time is running out, that eye is approaching

dialogue.content: "Wait—why should I believe you?" Chen Ji said coldly. "Even the First Observer could be a character fabricated by those beings."

text.content: The old man's phantom showed no anger; instead, a gratified smile appeared on his face.

choices.description: Refuse the existing options, attempting to create a unique solution to break the deadlock based on his understanding of the Tianji Record and the experience of previous observers.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate for calculation
choices.visible_reward: May discover hidden routes unknown to others
choices.risk_hint: Success or failure entirely depends on your calculation ability

dialogue.content: "Interesting..." A flicker of light appeared in the eyes of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. "You want to find your own way out?"

text.content: Complex emotions appeared in the old man's phantom eyes—anticipation mixed with worry.

Just as Chen Ji was weighing his options, a strange fluctuation suddenly emanated from the depths of the imperial mausoleum.

The fluctuation was gentle yet resolute, like winter sunlight piercing through layers of mist, or a long-awaited reunion's call.

The old man's phantom expression changed dramatically—for the first time since his appearance, he showed signs of wavering.

"She's here..."

In the void, a figure slowly materialized. Chen Ji's heart tightened—

It was his missing sister, Chen Nian.

She looked exactly as he remembered, except her eyes held a depth he had never seen before. Strange light surrounded her, as if she had some natural connection to this imperial mausoleum and that complete page of the Tianji Record.

Chen Nian looked at Chen Ji, the corner of her lips curving slightly upward: "Brother, I'm back."

The voice was like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. The ten-thousand-year scheme, the chessboard of fate, the dimensional wars—at this moment, none of it seemed as important as the smile before him.

Chen Nian walked slowly toward Chen Ji, each step leaving faint light traces in the void.

"I've been waiting for you." Her voice was clear and calm. "The Holy Sect took me, not to use me—but because I'm the only one who can balance the dimensional fluctuations of the Tianji Record."

She raised her hand, gently touching the complete golden page: "The First Observer discovered that breaking through dimensional封锁, the observer's power alone is insufficient. He needed an anchor—a bridge connecting the emotional bonds of the three-dimensional world with higher-dimensional laws."

Chen Ji suddenly understood.

The reason Chen Nian was the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' wasn't because she could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight—because she herself was the link between Chen Ji and higher dimensions!

Her existence was to prevent Chen Ji from losing himself while pursuing the fourth possibility.

But what did this mean?

dialogue.content: "The price of the fourth possibility, Brother." A trace of sorrow flashed in Chen Nian's eyes. "You need to sacrifice everything you cherish most—including me."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's appearance changed the situation; Chen Ji must re-evaluate his choices:

choices.description: Chen Nian is his only remaining family. No matter the situation, he would never use his sister as the price for any possibility. Search for other solutions that don't require sacrificing her.
choices.visible_cost: May lose the best opportunity to break through dimensions
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the bond with his sister
choices.risk_hint: Those beings will not let you go easily

dialogue.content: Chen Ji grabbed Chen Nian's hand, his voice low but firm: "I've been scheming across the world for so many years, never for the sake of losing you."

text.content: Chen Nian's eyes reddened slightly, yet she smiled.

choices.description: Not hasty to make decisions, demanding the old man and Chen Nian lay out all information completely, including all details and variant plans of the fourth possibility.
choices.visible_cost: Time is slipping away, that eye growing ever closer
choices.visible_reward: More comprehensive information might bring a turning point
choices.risk_hint: The more information, the harder the choice

dialogue.content: "I need the complete truth." Chen Ji released Chen Nian's hand, his sharp gaze falling upon the old man. "Sacrificing everything most precious—this phrase itself is a trap. Who defines 'most precious'? What if I choose to sacrifice myself?"

text.content: The old man's phantom exchanged a glance with Chen Nian, as if communicating in silence.

choices.description: Agreeing to pursue the fourth possibility but explicitly refusing to use Chen Nian as the price, demanding alternative plans or changes to the execution of the rules.
choices.visible_cost: Need for additional negotiation and compromise

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's lips curved into a familiar arc: "I can accept the fourth possibility. But the rules—I will set them."

text.content: A flicker of surprise flashed in the old man's phantom's eyes, then transformed into deep approval.

The old man's phantom fell silent for a moment, then let out a long sigh.

"You truly are different from him."

He waved his hand, and the complete golden page spread out once more, countless words and diagrams flowing forth like water. Chen Ji saw that this information not only contained methods to break through dimensions, but also the failure experiences of observers throughout history and their dying insights.

"The essence of the fourth possibility is to make the observer become a medium connecting the three dimensions with higher dimensions." The old man's voice grew solemn. "But every observer throughout history made the same mistake—they tried to bear this process alone."

Chen Nian interjected: "So the first observer left me behind. I am Chen Ji's blood relative, and the only bond he cannot sever. If anyone could share this burden..."

Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji: "It would be me."

The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently at this moment, the distance between the two pages growing ever closer. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a relieved sigh.

"Finally... finally reaching this step."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, whatever happens next, remember—" Mo Xiansheng's voice became ethereal, "Your schemes were never about defeating fate. They were about protecting those you wish to protect."

text.content:
Chen Ji looked at Chen Nian before him, then at the Tianji Record page about to unite.

He had schemed across the world for so many years, his calculations flawless, treating everyone as a chess piece. Only Chen Nian was the one existence on his chessboard that could not be manipulated.

Now, she stood before him, telling him she was willing to share the weight of fate for him.

In the heavens above, that giant eye drew ever closer. The aura of dimensional invasion had begun eroding the barrier of the imperial tomb, time running out.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and made one of the most important decisions of his life.

"Chen Nian." His voice was calm, yet carried undeniable power. "If this is about sharing, then it's not your burden alone."

He extended his hand, intertwining his fingers with hers: "I've schemed across the world for so many years, never to lose anyone. This time, I'm taking you with me."

The two pages of the Tianji Record collided with a thunderous sound, golden light engulfing the entire imperial tomb.

And within the light, Chen Ji heard the final words of the first observer:

"Remember—the fourth possibility requires sacrificing everything most precious to you. But what is most precious is not what you possess... but what you are willing to give up for."

The golden light gradually faded.

Chen Ji felt his soul had undergone a complete tempering, the complete power of the Tianji Record flowing through his body. He could clearly sense every corner of the three-dimensional world, the movements of those dimensional invaders, the terrifying existence watching from higher dimensions.

But at the same time, he also felt Chen Nian's heartbeat—perfectly synchronized with his own.

"Brother." Chen Nian's voice came from the void, carrying a tired yet sincere smile. "We did it."

Chen Ji gripped her hand tightly, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

"No, this is just the beginning."

He looked up at the heavens, that giant eye still watching, but Chen Ji no longer felt fear. He saw the truth behind that eye—it was not the Heavenly Way, not the end of fate, but a group of beings trapped in higher dimensions, trying to prolong their own existence by devouring lower-dimensional worlds.

If that was the case...

A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes: "Since you treat us as experimental data, let me show you the final result of this experiment."

The complete Tianji Record appeared in his palm, the text on the first page slowly changing—

"The Fourth Possibility—Transcending Three Dimensions. Unlocking."

And the price of unlocking, as the old man said:

Sacrifice everything most precious to you.

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to Chen Nian beside him, his eyes gentle yet firm: "Don't worry, I will find a method that requires no sacrifice from anyone."

After all, scheming across the world for so many years, he never intended to become a chess piece of fate—to become the one who moves the pieces.

Dimensional invaders?

Very well.

Let me show you the手段 of the world's foremost chess master.

Deep within the imperial tomb, the golden light gradually calmed.

Chen Ji and Chen Nian stood side by side, the complete Tianji Record hovering above them both, emanating a gentle yet authoritative glow. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul weakly adhered to the fragment, yet his eyes shimmered with unprecedented relief.

"You succeeded." The old man's voice had grown ethereal. "But this is merely the beginning. The dimensional invaders will not sit idle as you grow, and the complete unlocking of the fourth possibility requires more..." His form began to dissipate.

"What else is needed?" Chen Ji pressed.

The old man gave no answer, only casting his gaze toward Chen Nian, a complex emotion flickering briefly in his eyes.

Chen Nian gently tightened her grip on Chen Ji's hand, her voice calm yet carrying an imperceptible tremor: "Brother, whatever is needed, we face it together."
